apps.name: Busquets
apps.subtitle: Receive, scan, decide, release, at your own pace
apps.localizedDescription: Sketches of being the pivot, in one app. Tap a door: Iron Filings (you never touch the ball), Lighthouse (the scan is a beam), The Hole (a real moment with him taken out), Pivot, Pulse, Rondo Garden, Watch, Eyes, Ghost (real matches replayed; StatsBomb open data fetched at run time, as in The Hole) or Light (his passes as light). Swipe in from the left edge to come back. Working title.
